name: Angled purple loosestrife
desc: Angled purple loosestrife (Lythrum alatum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 11 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lythrum alatum, commonly known as winged loosestrife, winged lythrum or angled purple-loosestrife, is a species of flowering plant belonging to the family Lythraceae.
